items.source: true if the annotation matches
items.translation: true 如果注解匹配

items.source: since the MergedAnnotations model always ignores lang annotations according to the PLAIN filter, for efficiency reasons
items.translation: 由于出于效率原因，MergedAnnotations 模型始终根据PLAIN过滤器忽略 lang 注解。

items.source: AnnotationFilter that matches annotations in the java and javax packages and their subpackages.
items.translation: 匹配 `java` 和 `javax` 包及其子包中注解的AnnotationFilter。

items.source: AnnotationFilter that always matches and can be used when no relevant annotation types are expected to be present at all.
items.translation: 始终匹配且可在完全不预期存在相关注解类型时使用的AnnotationFilter。

items.source: Create a new AnnotationFilter that matches annotations in the specified packages.
items.translation: 创建一个新的AnnotationFilter接口，以匹配指定包中的注解。

items.source: Note that the MergedAnnotations model (which this interface has been designed for) always ignores lang annotations according to the PLAIN filter (for efficiency reasons). Any additional filters and even custom filter implementations apply within this boundary and may only narrow further from here.
items.translation: 请注意，MergedAnnotations 模型（本接口是为此设计的）始终根据 PLAIN 过滤器忽略语言注解（出于效率原因）。任何额外的过滤器甚至自定义过滤器实现均在此边界内应用，并且只能在此基础上进一步缩小范围。

items.source: This is the default filter in the MergedAnnotations model.
items.translation: 这是 `MergedAnnotations` 模型中的默认过滤器。

items.source: AnnotationFilter that matches annotations in the java.lang and org.springframework.lang packages and their subpackages.
items.translation: 匹配 `java.lang` 和 `org.springframework.lang` 包及其子包中注解的AnnotationFilter。

items.source: AnnotationFilter that never matches and can be used when no filtering is needed (allowing for any annotation types to be present).
items.translation: AnnotationFilter 永远不会匹配，可用于不需要过滤的情况（允许存在任何注解类型）。

items.source: Test if the given annotation matches the filter.
items.translation: 测试给定的注解是否与过滤器匹配。

items.source: Test if the given type matches the filter.
items.translation: 测试给定类型是否与过滤器匹配。

items.source: Test if the given type name matches the filter.
items.translation: 测试给定的类型名称是否与过滤器匹配。

items.source: a new AnnotationFilter instance
items.translation: 一个新的AnnotationFilter实例

items.translation: typeName - 要测试的注解类型的完全限定类名

items.translation: packages - 应匹配的注解包
